name: Default
shortDescription: Official Bitwarden lite password manager server with the web vault, a MariaDB database and persistent vault data.

alerts.message: BW_INSTALLATION_ID starts as a random ID so the server can boot, and BW_INSTALLATION_KEY is empty. Generate your own installation ID and key at bitwarden.com/host, set both, then redeploy to enable mobile push notifications and licensed features.

Anyone who can reach the domain can create an account: register yours, then set DISABLE_USER_REGISTRATION to true and redeploy. The System Administrator Portal at /admin signs in by emailed link, so it needs SMTP_HOST, the SMTP credentials and ADMIN_EMAILS.
HTTPS is required: the web vault and clients only work over the generated secure domain.
